name: mvtcdf
comment: Sig: p = mvtcdf(X, C, df). For d=1 exact via tcdf (bit-equal MATLAB R2025b). For d≥2 deterministic Monte Carlo on Y = Z/sqrt(W/df) with W ~ chi²(df), seed=12345, 10000 antithetic draws → ~0.005 MC error per row. Fingerprint pins d=1 to 1e-8 (exact) and d=2,3 to 0.02 MC tolerance. KNOWN GAPs: [LB, UB] box-form mvtcdf(L, U, C, df) and 'tol' option deferred.
